Name: Kzinti's Massive Green House
Author: kzintiwife
Description:
This mod uses Content Patcher to replace the greenhouse. the main room is a warp and adds 8 color coded greenhouse rooms, 2 tree rooms, and a room with water for paddies. They can grow grass!  They have warps to get around the maps as well as a warp system to get from one to the other without having to go back to the main room. 


this is a revisioning of my older 1.4 mod but enough changes were made that i'm making this its own mod. 

- KZ


to use

install content patcher. 
drop this in the mods folder.


A Great BIG Thank You to Kyrinia & rokugin for helping me find out why spacecore was needed and removing it!


PS:  if you do the beta - there are 8 rooms of 4 types of rooms. config to allow 0 to 8 for each. If you put 0 for all 4, you wont get any greenhouse spaces. if you have basic config mod, you can change the number of rooms dynamically.

Downloads.Description: fixed npc pathing so no longer needs spacecore dependency (Great Thanks to Kyrinia & Rokugin)
